This tool uses a multi-agent architecture in which conversation content is first sorted, and then processed sequentially by agents with different roles.

For example, small talk and general inquiries are handled by a general information agent; store-related inquiries and lost and found items are handled by a separate general information agent; symptom consultations are handled by a symptom analysis agent; and urgent matters are handled by an emergency information agent.
